title: Make standard s-go-vet-run pass
body: Outcome: `krn standards check --record s-go-vet-run` no longer fails s-go-vet-run.

Why: adoption found this reflex standard failing: exit 1 from git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)\.golangci\.(yml|yaml|toml|json)$' || git grep -qIE 'go vet|golangci|staticcheck' -- .github Makefile makefile GNUmake...
Files: the files the failing check names (run the Proof command).
